story_summary: The Last Mile describes his path from its entrepreneurship and coding programs to founding Fitness Monkey. His own website publicly describes his work as a founder, speaker and mentor.

In a first-person letter published by Google.org, Jones describes learning to code through The Last Mile and becoming a software engineer. This is a historical story, not a verification of current employment.

In a first-person article published by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Tamboura discusses his experience with The Last Mile and his work in criminal justice reform. Roles described belong to the publication period.
